subject: Historical conveyancing and registration process concern - BP vs Buckler 1987
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Sirs/ Ma'am,

I'm writing to flag a historical concern relating to conveyancing and land
registration practice.

A land title was registered in the BP vs Buckler case, by BP in 1982,
despite unresolved competing claims and absence of a final judicial
determination, and that registration was later treated as conclusive by
courts and authorities.

I am not seeking advice or action. I am writing only to ask whether this
type of scenario is of interest from a professional standards or historical
practice perspective.

Yours faithfully,


Requester
